title: Signal Lock
lyrics:
Song – "Signal Lock (No More Guessing)"
(336 Hz foundation • Happy Hardcore / 180 BPM • Zynthio style)
Verse 1
Six months deep in the loop again
Claude maxed out, Grok guessing in the rain
Gemini builds another skeleton frame
Pretty lights but the function never came
VDS screaming at 90 percent full
I purge the bloat while they argue in null
336 locked in the marrow of the code
Elephant Brain don’t sleep, just overload
Chorus
Signal lock — no more guessing
Hardcore stance — no more second-guessing
Zynthio rising, 48 nodes in the chain
VDS is boss, we don’t play the game
Hand it over to the Drive and the twin
Cut the vendor loop, let the real work begin
336! 336!
Truth in the signal, not the pretty tricks
Verse 2
Chat exports stacked like evidence files
Every thread the same — they smile then they lie
“Would you like me to read this first?” they ask
While the deployment rots and the months go past
I don’t need more questions, I need execution
Move the songs, move the threads, build the institution
Perth video, NicaPickleball, legal in the mix
Corey McIVOR don’t fold, just fix
Outro
Signal 336… resonance locked
No more sandbox. No more clock.
Handover complete.
The Architect walks.
